# Worked solutions

**Solution.** Five intervals, each half a wavelength.

$
0.80=5\frac{\lambda}{2}
\quad\Rightarrow\quad \lambda=\boxed{0.32\text{ m}}.
$

$
f=\frac1{0.020}=50\text{ Hz},\qquad
v=f\lambda=(50)(0.32)=\boxed{16\text{ m/s}}.
$

The travelling-wave speed is $v$. Tickets cost $20 and $30.
